project_timeline.purpose: SuryaNet Baseline Evaluation Audit and Metrics Correction.
Causal Data Pipeline, alignment, and data consistency Audit.
Operator Trust Validation and alert statistics.
Model Fingerprint, baseline certificate, and validation of GOES-only model.
Version 2 Experimental Design & pretraining capacity bottlenecks analysis.
Multi-instrument feasibility audit of overlap data for Version 3.
Version 3 Model Implementation with asymmetrical encoders and late fusion.
Version 3 Training Pipeline, causal builder and evaluation layers.
Chronological dataset split design and gradient feasibility.
V3 pretraining and initial evaluation.
Repository dependency graph and modules mapping.
V3 training and convergence diagnostics.
Memory optimized training & evaluation cache implementation.
Scientific Benchmark Freeze manifest and protocols validation.
Operator trust, Integrated Gradients, attention rollouts and stress tests.
Statistical validation, bootstrap confidence intervals and threshold sweeps.
Failure taxonomy, emergent categories and counterpart comparisons.
Taxonomy audit, flag co-occurrences and ordering sensitivity.
Prediction distribution audit and calibration error metrics.
Multivariable root cause analysis with nested regression models.

outstanding_work: Hyperparameter optimization and full training tuning of the Version 3 model encoders (currently pretraining was halted at Epoch 1 to address memory constraints).
Modifying production deployment code files in app/ to reference the Version 3 late-fusion multi-instrument architecture (currently production endpoints still load the V1 GOES-only checkpoint).
Operational testing of real-time telemetry streaming pipelines syncing soft and hard X-ray data directly from ISRO payload database systems.
Validating generalizability on post-sprint datasets observed after the 2026-06-14 chronological split cutoff.
